contract_name: Conceptual Physics Student Figure Answer-Neutrality Contract
scope: Every student-facing figure, diagram, graph, table-image, annotated photo, model, ray/vector/circuit/field sketch, and caption used by Banks or downstream Physics resources.
hard_rule: NEVER SHOW THE ANSWER IN THE STUDENT IMAGE.
interpretation: If the student is supposed to identify, infer, rank, label, calculate, predict, critique, construct, compare, or determine a feature, the student-facing visual may not already name, mark, highlight, draw, state, or numerically reveal that feature.
answer_bearing_examples_to_remove_or_hid: force names on arrows when students must identify forces
arrow direction or completed vector when students must determine direction/vector
numerical magnitude/value when students must calculate or infer it
rank numbers/order labels when students must rank cases
circled/highlighted error or corrected feature when students must critique a model
completed ray path/image location when students must construct or predict it
completed graph trend/point/line when students must predict, plot, or infer it
current direction/path/component label when students must determine circuit behavior
caption/title/legend text that states the conclusion or response
teacher-answer annotations accidentally copied into the student figure
source_figure_rule: Hewitt/source captures and Framework reusable figures are REFERENCES, not automatically student-safe assets. Inspect the actual image against the exact prompt. Crop, edit, redraw, generate an answer-neutral student variant, or choose a different figure whenever the original contains answer-bearing information.
student_teacher_split: A teacher key may use a separate annotated/labeled answer figure. That teacher figure must use a different file/reference and must never be referenced by the student item.

figure_metadata_required_in_bank.container: Each entry in canonical item.figures must be an object, not a bare filename string.
figure_metadata_required_in_bank.answer_neutrality_verified: Must be boolean true only after inspecting the actual student image against the exact student prompt.

hard_failures: A student image or its title/caption/legend directly supplies the requested response.
A canonical Physics Bank figure reference lacks explicit answer-neutrality verification metadata.
An answer-sensitive figure task lacks answer_bearing_elements_removed=true.
A teacher-answer figure is referenced by a student-facing item.
A representation-required evidence job is converted to text-only solely to avoid answer leakage.
qa.manual_visual_gate: Mechanical QA cannot reliably read pixels. Before release, visually inspect every student-facing figure used by an answer-sensitive item. Metadata is a signed assertion of that inspection, not a substitute for it.

representation_preservation_rule: Answer-neutrality is NOT permission to remove a representation required by the I-can. If students must read/create/critique a diagram, graph, vector, force model, ray, field, circuit, or table, provide an answer-neutral version of that representation. Text-only substitution is not equivalent evidence.
inline_svg_rule: Inline SVG is a student figure. Record it in the canonical figures[] metadata with render_mode=inline_svg, student_evidence_role, answer_neutrality_verified=true, and answer_bearing_elements_removed=true when the task is answer-sensitive. A missing file field is allowed only for a true inline SVG metadata record.
